text:
sarah-support: FYI customer acme-prod reporting a sudden wave of 401s (invalid_api_key) when uploading files via multipart/form-data to POST /v1/files. They're using a CI job to hit our hosted API. Repro curl they provided below.
sarah-support: ```curl -X POST 
  -H 'Authorization: ApiKey acme/api/key' 
  -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' 
  -F 'file=@./report.pdf' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/files```

michael-support: Logged the trace id they sent, forwarded to eng. any quick checks we can ask them to validate?

alex-engineer: Quick sanity: ask them to echo the exact Authorization header on their CI runner before the request (e.g. `echo "$AUTH_HEADER" | xxd`) to check for invisible chars or truncated values. Also confirm they're not accidentally sending the SSM/Secrets Manager parameter name instead of the value.

sarah-support: asked them to run `echo -n "$API_KEY" | xxd` and posted back the output. customer says they copied value from their pipeline var which is populated by an `aws ssm get-parameter` step.

raj-engineer: If they're using the parameter store, sometimes the step outputs a JSON/object and users copy the key name or ARN by mistake. Can they `aws ssm get-parameter --name "/acme/api/key" --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text` and confirm?

acme-ops (via customer): we ran the suggested check, here's the xxd output of the header: `00000000: 6163 6d65 2f61 7069 2f6b 6579                      acme/api/key`

michael-support: That output shows they're literally sending the parameter name `acme/api/key` as the key. That's why our auth fails (invalid value).

sarah-support: asked customer to pull the parameter value with the `--query Parameter.Value` command and replace the pipeline variable with that value. Provided example.

raj-engineer: Also added note: if their CI step is `aws ssm get-parameter --name ...` without `--query Parameter.Value --output text` it will return JSON, and some templating can end up with the parameter "Name" or ARN. We should add a short troubleshooting snippet to docs.

acme-ops: confirmed fix — swapped pipeline var to the parameter value, re-ran job, request succeeded. 200 OK and file uploaded. :tada:

sarah-support: marking resolved, will follow up with a short doc snippet and share with customer.
